instruction.text: Select the golden dome to learn more about the Sultan Omar Saifudden Mosque.

end.text: This is a photo of the Sultan Omar Saifudden Mosque in Brunei. It is right next to the Brunei river and is one of the most beautiful mosques in the Asian Pacific!

instruction.text: Select the waterfall to find out more about the Seiganto-ji Temple.
instruction.sound: Select the waterfall to find out more about the Sayganto-gee Temple.

end.text: The Seiganto-Ji Temple is a Buddhist temple in Wakayama, Japan and is dedicated to the goddess of mercy, Kannon.

instruction.text: Select the dome to learn more about the Florence Cathedral.

end.text: The Florence Cathedral is a church in Florence, Italy. The building was finished in 1436; this means the church is almost 600 years old!

instruction.text: Select one of the towers to learn about the Neasden Temple.

end.text: The Neasden Temple is a Hindu temple in London, England. It is made out of hand-carved stone.

instruction.text: Select the circular window to learn more about the Eldridge Street Synagogue.

end.text: This is the Eldridge Street Synagogue. It’s a Jewish synagogue in New York City. It was built in 1887 and is in the Chinatown neighbourhood.
